newsitem.title: USA: Southern Farley nuke reduces power for work.
newsitem.headline: Southern Farley nuke reduces power for work.

text.p: Southern Co's Southern Nuclear Operating Co said Thursday its 812 megawatt (MW) Farley nuclear power unit 1 reduced output for a repair but should return to full service by the weekend.
"Power has been reduced to about 28 percent (of capacity) for maintenance but it should be at 100 percent by the weekend," said spokeswoman Loretto Stevens.
Power output was cut to 28 percent on Wednesday after a steam stop valve was found to have changed position, Stevens said.
Repairs to the valve could be complete later today, and the unit would then begin to boost power output, she said.
The adjacent 822 MW Farley unit 2 continued to operate normally at 100 percent of capacity.
